comment: M4 TARGET-TEST golden registry (fix_plan §M4 task 11). A SIBLING of manifest.json: the ^[ms] match/scenario grammar there is byte-frozen and byte-pinned by check-ai-live.sh, so target goldens (id ^t[0-9]{2}$) live in this separate file with their own recorder (record-target.sh -> run-target.js), freezer (freeze-target.js), and verifiers (the UNCHANGED oracle/harness/verify-stream.js for the spec-v1 PLAYER stream + verify-target-stream.js for the SEPARATE target-plane stream, per the iter-63 convention). HARD RULE 3 stands: only M0 writes oracle/ — run-target.js reuses the oracle harness bytes VERBATIM by path and every stream is judged by the UNCHANGED oracle verifier. Target mode is single-player (slot 0): p2/stage are null, cpu false, difficulty null; `char` is the slot-0 character (0 marth 1 puff 2 fox 3 falco 4 falcon) and `tstage` is the target stage 0-9 (== upstream activeStage.js targetStageMapping == targetstage1..10). Every target trace is CRAFTED by a committed deterministic generator gen-<id>-trace.js (no gen-trace.js chaos; `seed` is ONLY the run's Math.random seed — the ONE off-step draw is startTargetGame's background draw, targetplay.js:187, so rngCallsOutsideStep == 1 like VS). Quality contract (check-target-quality.js, MECHANICAL): gameMode === 5, playing true at the final frame, stocks == 1, NO ^DEAD state (the player never SDs in-trace), targetsDestroyed >= 2, endTargetGame false throughout (all-broken is never reached: finishGame is FOH plane, trapped in C); t01 additionally maxArticles > 0 (live laser flight). t01 fox/tstage1: TWO article (laser) breaks. t02 falcon/tstage2: TWO melee breaks, zero articles. A45 T6 widened `tstage` to 0-19 and added the REQUIRED `customStage` key: 0-9 is an AUTHORED stage with an empty code, 10-19 is a CUSTOM slot (MLK_PLAYING_BASE + slot, upstream's own numbering at targetselect.js:140-146) whose share code is played through upstream's OWN parseStageCode in-page, after run-target.js proves the code is a fixed point of createStageCode. t03 fox/custom slot 0 is the DAMAGE golden: its stage is two grounds meeting at x=0 with walls at either end (connected `g:r0|g1,g0|l0`, so every getConnected link type but `p` is live), and the RIGHT ground carries damageType fire. The walk across the seam is carried onto the fire by `connected` and takes 10% at sim frame 264 (WALK -> DAMAGEFLYN) — the first execution of dealWithDamagingStageCollision in this project. It is what discharged mlk_stage_playable's damage refusal, and port/sim/target/check-custom-stage.sh leg [5] fails if it ever stops covering that plane.
